facts.text: Cedric's signed promissory note obliges him to pay the party 975 gold (three-quarters price) for their treasure once the caravans flow again and the goods can be trucked to town.
The party owes Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment out of Cedric's promissory note for joining the party.
facts.uncertain_reason: The exact terms or shares promised to Malzazarik and Lady Hilda from the note were not stated.
